cases.synthetic_setup: Two synthetic projects; request has no established principal.
cases.probe: Read an element through the actual admitted REST entry point.
cases.candidate_goal: Record the selected anonymous-access policy and show its enforcement before choosing an authenticated Rust mode.

cases.synthetic_setup: Synthetic principal A has access only to project A; element B belongs to project B.
cases.probe: Ask the admitted element operation for B while authenticated as A.
cases.candidate_goal: For a proposed isolated host mode, reject disclosure across the reviewed project permission boundary; exact native HTTP outcome remains unqualified.

cases.synthetic_setup: Synthetic A is restricted to project A; related element B belongs to project B.
cases.probe: Query the relationships operation using B and both directions.
cases.candidate_goal: Check denial/no foreign relationship data, rather than accepting an empty-data fixture as evidence of authorization.

cases.synthetic_setup: Projects A and B contain the same element ID but different marker data.
cases.probe: Read by ID in each allowed context and attempt the other project context.
cases.candidate_goal: Require identity to retain project context and detect accidental ID-only lookup; principal policy must be reviewed first.

cases.synthetic_setup: Synthetic principal A; request pairs project A with semantic-data/editing-context ID B.
cases.probe: Send the mismatched identifiers through real request/context resolution.
cases.candidate_goal: Reject a foreign context substitution in the proposed isolated host mode; mapping existence alone is not authorization.

cases.synthetic_setup: A disposable test session has expired under the bound effective configuration.
cases.probe: Repeat read and command requests with the expired session identifier.
cases.candidate_goal: Record expiry enforcement and prove no cached identity is accepted without revalidation.

cases.synthetic_setup: A synthetic subscribed session is revoked using the selected logout mechanism.
cases.probe: Observe the existing subscription and attempt reconnect after revocation.
cases.candidate_goal: Define and verify revocation semantics for active and reconnecting transports; no native lifecycle is presumed.

cases.synthetic_setup: Disposable origins allowed.invalid and denied.invalid under a reviewed effective policy.
cases.probe: Send preflight and credentialed requests from each origin.
cases.candidate_goal: Capture actual allow-origin/credentials headers and browser result; source property declarations do not decide runtime policy.

cases.synthetic_setup: Synthetic upgrade request supplies a disallowed origin and separately an expired identity.
cases.probe: Attempt the actual inherited WebSocket upgrade and subscription operation.
cases.candidate_goal: Check upgrade and subscription gates separately from HTTP CORS; record the chosen origin/identity policy.

cases.synthetic_setup: A synthetic cookie session and a state-changing command; only disposable model data.
cases.probe: Compare missing/invalid/valid anti-CSRF evidence through the actual command entry.
cases.candidate_goal: Determine whether CSRF applies to the selected authentication mode, then verify the effective protection or an explicitly reviewed alternative.

cases.synthetic_setup: Bound HTTPS/proxy configuration and a synthetic login/session establishment.
cases.probe: Inspect actual Set-Cookie attributes and subsequent requests without storing session secrets.
cases.candidate_goal: Qualify Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite/domain/path/lifetime against explicit deployment policy; TLS documentation alone supplies no cookie proof.

cases.synthetic_setup: A source checkout and a candidate JAR/image whose digest has not been reconciled.
cases.probe: Compare the exact dependency/source/config receipt with the artifact used for all observations.
cases.candidate_goal: Refuse attribution of runtime results to source until the artifact and effective policy are bound.
